figures.caption: Figure 1. Claustrum input to anterior cingulate cortex is required for optimal cueguided switching.
Figure 2. The architecture of UP/DOWN cycling tracks behavioral engagement.
Figure 3. Claustrum activity leads the cortical UP-to-DOWN transition and supplies a low-dimensional, axis-aligned drive.
Figure 4. A coordinated claustral volley, not a rise in firing rate, accompanies the cortical UP-to-DOWN transition.
Figure 5. Claustrum input directionally and causally controls cortical state durations.
